steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes are differentially expressed between 6 psoriasis lesional and 6 control skin samples, using the filtered log2(TPM+1) matrix from T1S1?
acceptance_criteria: Fits limma linear model (lmFit + eBayes with trend=TRUE, i.e. limma-trend) on filtered log2(TPM+1) values with an unpaired two-group design matrix (lesional vs control) matching metadata.csv condition labels

Produces a volcano plot and a top-25 heatmap of DE genes across the 12 samples labeled by condition

Explicitly states in the report that this used limma-trend on TPM-derived log-expression rather than a count-based negative-binomial model (DESeq2/edgeR/voom), because raw counts were not delivered, and that this is the standard substitution used in the literature (Ritchie et al. 2015, PMID 25605792) when only normalized continuous expression is available

If the DE list is very short (few genes at FDR<0.05), report low power explicitly rather than lowering the threshold silently

acceptance_criteria: Uses the significant DE gene list (FDR<0.05, split into up-in-lesional and down-in-lesional) from T1S2 as input, with the filtered gene universe from T1S1 as background

Runs over-representation analysis (hypergeometric/Fisher) separately for up- and down-regulated gene sets against the correct background, reporting BH-adjusted p-values
Outputs a ranked table of significant pathways (adj p < 0.05) with the overlapping gene symbols, and flags if no reference is found rather than fabricating pathway hits

steps.name: Immune and keratinocyte cell composition shift
caveats: n=6 vs 6 gives very limited statistical power for cell-composition comparisons — report as hypothesis-generating
These deconvolution signature sets were built mainly for tumor microenvironment context, not skin; interpret keratinocyte/epidermal signal with caution
steps.question: Do the relative fractions of immune and skin cell types (T cells, myeloid cells, keratinocytes) estimated from bulk TPM differ between lesional and control skin, consistent with a psoriasis immune infiltrate signature?
acceptance_criteria: Runs at least one TPM-compatible deconvolution/signature-scoring method (e.g. quanTIseq or EPIC via immunedeconv, or MCPcounter) on the TPM matrix (these methods are designed for normalized continuous input, unlike some count-based deconvolution tools)
Reports per-sample estimated cell-type fractions/scores for the 12 samples and compares lesional vs control with a non-parametric test (Wilcoxon rank-sum, n=6 vs 6) given the small sample size
States the result as descriptive/exploratory given n=6 per group and does not overclaim clinical cell-composition conclusions
Flags explicitly if the chosen deconvolution method's marker genes are largely tumor-microenvironment/immune-oncology focused and thus only partially relevant to skin epidermal composition

steps.name: PPI network hub analysis of DE genes
caveats: protein.links.v12.0.txt.gz is space-delimited despite .txt extension and ~83MB gzipped with ~13.7M rows (each edge doubled) — read with a space-delimited parser and de-duplicate, and do not attempt distance measures on the unfiltered full graph
STRING ids are taxid-prefixed Ensembl protein ids, not gene symbols — the info file join is mandatory before matching to the DE gene list
steps.question: Among genes differentially expressed between lesional and control skin (T1S2), which form highly connected hubs in the human protein-protein interaction network, suggesting central regulatory nodes in the psoriasis expression signature?
acceptance_criteria: Loads STRING human v12.0 protein info and protein links files present in the reference store, joins protein.info preferred_name to protein.links STRING ids to recover gene symbols
Filters to combined_score >= 700 (documented high-confidence threshold) and de-duplicates the doubled edge direction before building an undirected graph
Subsets the network to nodes present in the FDR<0.05 DE gene list from T1S2 plus their direct interactors, computes degree/betweenness centrality within this subnetwork
Reports the top 15-20 hub genes by degree centrality with their DE direction (up/down in lesional) and logFC from T1S2
States this is a correlative network-topology observation, not evidence of causal regulatory hierarchy

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM table
plan.analytical_narrative: The core delivered only a gene-level TPM matrix (12000 genes x 12 samples, 6 lesional vs 6 control, Salmon-derived, no raw counts, no quantification directories) plus a 12x2 metadata table. Standard count-based DE tools (DESeq2, edgeR exact/GLM, standard voom-from-counts) require raw or estimated read counts to model the mean-variance trend correctly; applying them to TPM values violates their assumptions and produces unreliable p-values. The literature-grounded route for expression data that arrives already normalized/continuous (Ritchie et al. 2015, Nucleic Acids Research, PMID 25605792) is limma's array-style empirical Bayes pipeline: log2-transform the TPM (with a pseudocount), fit limma-trend (eBayes with trend=TRUE, which estimates a mean-variance trend directly from log-expression values rather than from counts) to get moderated t-statistics and FDR-controlled results for the unpaired 6 vs 6 design. This is analogous to what voom (Law et al. 2014, PMID 24485249) does for read counts, but consumes continuous TPM directly and does not fabricate a count model that isn't supported by the data. The plan documents this substitution explicitly as a caveat rather than silently treating TPM as counts. After DE, gene identities differing between lesional and control are characterized functionally (WikiPathways human pathway enrichment, present in the reference store), by immune/keratinocyte cell composition shift (relevant given psoriasis pathobiology: T cell, myeloid, keratinocyte fractions), and by a PPI-network view of the top DE genes via STRING to flag hub genes. These three downstream layers are the standard interpretive layers for a psoriasis skin transcriptome DE gene list and use references and packages confirmed present in this environment (WikiPathways human GMT, STRING v12.0 human PPI, DoRothEA human regulons for optional TF-activity annotation, immunedeconv/EPIC/quantiseqr/MCPcounter for deconvolution). No steps assume raw counts exist anywhere.
